description: This file contains a controller class `CustomerGroup` for the admin section of an OpenCart-based e-commerce system. It manages customer group data including listing, retrieving info, generating JSON files, and clearing generated files. The class interacts with models for tasks, customer groups, stores, languages, and custom fields, and implements methods for automating and managing customer group related data tasks.

classes.name: CustomerGroup
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer group data in the OpenCart admin panel

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes tasks for customer group management, such as clearing old data, listing data, and generating info for each customer group.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates JSON file listing customer groups for each store and language.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Generates detailed JSON info for a specific customer group.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes previously generated JSON files related to customer groups.
